items.name: kividb
items.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in

readme.excerpt:
KiviDB is a fast, multi-threaded alternative to Redis® and Valkey, written in Rust. It speaks the Redis protocol (RESP2 and RESP3), so existing Redis clients, redis-cli and libraries work unchanged, and it has full-text and vector search built in. It runs every core on a sharded in-memory key-value design, and persists to snapshots and an optional append-only file.

On 32 cores of AWS bare metal, KiviDB 1.2.0 serves 21.2 million pipelined GETs per second: 9× Redis 8.10 and 2.3× Dragonfly , ahead of Garnet, at 0.36 ms p99 (benchmarks).

items.name: open-code-review
items.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

readme.excerpt:
Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started.

It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, ocr scan reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff.

A real-world code review benchmark built from 50 popular open-source repositories, 200 real Pull Requests, and 10 programming languages — cross-validated by 80+ senior engineers ( 1,505 annotated ground-truth issues).
features: Incomplete coverage — On larger changesets, agents tend to "cut corners," selectively reviewing only some files and missing others.
Position drift — Reported issues frequently don't match the actual code location, with line numbers or file references drifting off target.
Unstable quality — Natural-language-driven Skills are hard to debug, and review quality fluctuates significantly with minor prompt variation
Precise file selection — Determines exactly which files need review and which should be filtered, ensuring no important change is missed.
Smart file bundling — Groups related files into a single review unit (e.g., message en.properties and message zh.properties are bundled toge
Fine-grained rule matching — Matches review rules to each file's characteristics, keeping the model's attention sharply focused and eliminat
External positioning and reflection modules — Independent comment-positioning and comment-reflection modules systematically improve both the
Scenario-tuned prompts — Prompt templates deeply optimized for code review, improving effectiveness while reducing token consumption.

readme.excerpt:
简体中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español · Deutsch · Français · हिन्दी · Bahasa Indonesia · Português (Brasil) · Русский

「应用」页按来源整理应用。在应用详情里查看行为记录，再决定要不要改动。所有管理操作都由你发起，揪咪改动后会读回系统状态确认是否生效，系统拒绝时显示原因。

「设置 › 应用管理」的「执行身份」显示这些操作以谁的身份执行。使用 Root，或以 Root 启动的 Shizuku 时，停用、启用应用，以及卸载、恢复预装应用以 Root 身份执行，能更改手机不允许 shell 更改的系统应用。使用无线调试时，应用管理以 shell 身份执行。部分系统应用会受手机限制，揪咪会说明原因。自行安装的应用由 shell 卸载和恢复。卸载仅影响当前用户，工作资料或分身里的同一应用会保留。
features: 在 Android 11 或更高版本的手机上，从 GitHub Releases 下载并安装 APK。
首次打开时选择启动方式。推荐使用无线调试，在连接 Wi-Fi 后按引导允许通知、开启开发者选项，并在揪咪的通知里输入系统显示的 6 位配对码。
到「监测」页点「开始监测」。监测期间通知栏会显示常驻通知，可以从通知或 App 停止监测。
记录留在本机。 揪咪没有账号，也不上传监测记录。App 可从 GitHub 检查更新，选择更新后会下载安装包并校验大小、SHA-256 和签名。更新检查可关闭。
记录行为和连接信息。 揪咪可以显示某项权限被使用或访问被拒绝，无法看到聊天内容、密码或网络传输正文。
能看到的范围取决于系统。 短连接可能在两次读取之间结束，直接读取文件等行为可能没有可用信号。按连接统计流量需要 Android 14 或更高版本及系统支持。为减少误报，揪咪会略去部分无法确认的行为。
监测时会增加耗电。 耗电量取决于应用活动，不需要时可从通知停止监测。
